hero.title: Raising the standard of Vietnamese ingredients for global value chains.
hero.subtitle: Whitehorse Foodtech is building a premium B2B ingredient platform connecting farmers and processors more directly with manufacturers, brands and distributors — designed for fewer layers that add no value, and a more transparent, trusted supply chain.
hero.imageCaption: Illustrative images by ingredient family: coffee is an editorial photograph; the others are studio representations. Product, source and specification are confirmed per request.

thesis.body: Vietnam does not lack quality agricultural produce. What is missing is a system strong enough to turn that advantage into ingredients with clear standards, the right applications and sustainable access to markets.
thesis.close: Whitehorse was formed to close that gap.

bottlenecks.title: Large potential. Too little of the value retained.
bottlenecks.intro: Many Vietnamese crops still leave the chain as raw or lightly processed commodities, while more of the value is created further along — in processing, application development, standards and brand. The gap sits at six points.

items.title: Post-harvest technology
items.description: Uneven drying, storage and primary processing make quality hard to hold steady from growing area to factory.

items.title: R&D and application development
items.description: Ingredients are usually sold as commodities and rarely developed around a buyer's specific application — beverages, bakery, confectionery or nutrition.

items.title: Standards and quality documentation
items.description: Specifications, test methods and lot records are rarely organised in a way an international buyer can assess quickly.

items.title: Ingredient branding
items.description: Vietnamese ingredients are mostly recognised by general origin, not by their characteristics, quality or supply capability.

items.title: Market-access networks
items.description: Farmers and smaller processors struggle to reach manufacturers and brands directly, so value is spread across many intermediary layers.

items.title: Platform enterprises
items.description: Few enterprises act as infrastructure — connecting supply, processing capability, product data and market demand in one system.

role.title: From fragmented supply to an ingredient platform buyers can rely on.
role.body: Whitehorse does not own every farm, factory or technology. We are the connection and orchestration layer across four parts of the chain — supply, processing capability within our partner network, product and application data, and market demand — so each ingredient request is met with a suitable source, a clear specification and records that can be checked.

capabilities.title: Market Connection
capabilities.description: A more direct route from Vietnamese supply to manufacturers, brands, ingredient users and distribution partners.

control.body: Whitehorse is progressively building quality-assurance infrastructure — organising evidence, process and accountability around each of these points — so buyers can assess supply with clearer evidence, not promises.
control.note: Testing scope, documentation and COA are agreed for each order. Certifications belong to a specific supplier, site and scope.

mission.label: Mission
mission.body: To elevate the position of Vietnamese agriculture in global value chains through deep-processing capabilities, product development and a quality system that enables Vietnamese ingredients to be chosen for their value—not only their origin.

vision.label: Vision
vision.body: To become Vietnam's premium ingredient platform, where deep-processing capability, quality management and value-chain orchestration converge to bring Vietnamese ingredients into high-value supply chains worldwide.
vision.rolesNote: Roles we are building toward — not current services.

roles.title: Premium Ingredient Platform
roles.description: Where professional buyers find Vietnamese ingredients defined by specification, application and evidence.

roles.title: Deep-processing Technology Layer
roles.description: Connecting processing partners and technologies that move raw produce toward higher-value ingredient formats.

roles.title: Vietnamese Agricultural Value-chain Architect
roles.description: Designing how growing areas, processors, laboratories and buyers work together, with accountability at each step.

roles.title: Bridge to Global Ingredient Markets
roles.description: A dependable route for Vietnamese ingredients into the supply chains of international manufacturers and brands.

direction.label: Long-term direction
direction.title: Starting with ingredients. Designed for the whole agricultural chain.
direction.body: We start with ingredients because that is where standards and applications make the clearest difference. As data, standards and the network mature, the platform is designed to connect cooperatives, farmers, factories, laboratories, logistics providers and professional buyers — including direct quality-assurance and quality-control capability at key sourcing points.

ecosystem.title: Working with Balance Life on circular agriculture
ecosystem.body: Whitehorse Foodtech is currently working with Balance Life around a circular-agriculture initiative. The broader initiative brings together production, value-chain and finance participants. Participant names, scale and implementation scope are disclosed only when formally confirmed.

status.title: Where Whitehorse stands, and where it is heading
status.note: Current figures describe the network today. Three-year vision figures are direction, not a current track record.

coffee.name: Coffee Ingredients
coffee.tagline: Green, roasted, soluble, extract & cold brew
coffee.description: Coffee ingredients from Vietnam's main growing regions for food and beverage applications — green and roasted beans, soluble coffee, extracts and cold brew. Bulk, private-label and single-serve formats are discussed per project, with specification and packaging agreed to each product and market.

coconut.name: Coconut Ingredients
coconut.tagline: Milk & cream, powders & solids, blossom sugar
coconut.description: Vietnamese coconut made into versatile ingredients for food and beverage applications — from coconut milk and cream to coconut powders and coconut blossom sugar. Suitable for industrial food production and retail, with bulk supply and private-label options agreed to each market's requirements.

birdsNest.name: Bird's Nest Ingredients
birdsNest.description: Vietnamese edible bird's nest, selected and cleaned, as cleaned nest and instant or ready-to-prepare formats for health food, wellness retail, private-label RTD and nutraceutical applications. Concentrates, extracts, powders and functional blends are developed as OEM on request.

fruit.name: Fruit Ingredients
fruit.description: Vietnamese tropical fruits processed into shelf-stable ingredients. The core range covers soft-dried and freeze-dried mango, soft-dried soursop, and passion fruit as concentrate, frozen purée and powder, for food, beverage and nutrition applications. Other fruit formats are available on request or as OEM.

nutsSpicesBotanicals.name: Nuts, Spices & Botanicals
nutsSpicesBotanicals.tagline: Cashew, black pepper, freeze-dried cinnamon & star anise
nutsSpicesBotanicals.description: Selected Vietnamese nuts and spices graded to the buyer's specification. The core range covers cashew kernels, whole black pepper, freeze-dried cinnamon and freeze-dried star anise, with documentation agreed per order for food manufacturers and ingredient partners. Other botanicals are available on request.

hero.title: Quality & supplier qualification
hero.subtitle: Certificates belong to a specific supplier, site and product scope. We assess suppliers against the requirements of your product and destination market, and share the relevant certificates per order.

standards.title: Standards we check, by product and market
standards.subtitle: Which standards apply depends on the product and where it's going. These are the schemes we most often check during supplier assessment; which ones apply to a given supplier is confirmed per product and site.

items.name: ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000
items.description: A certified food safety management system — ISO 22000, FSSC 22000 or an equivalent recognized scheme — checked for the site and product scope in question.

items.name: HACCP
items.description: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Point plans reviewed for the product and process being quoted.

items.name: Organic Certification
items.description: Where a buyer needs organic product, we look for valid USDA Organic, EU Organic or equivalent certification covering that specific product and supplier.

items.name: FDA Registration
items.description: For US-bound orders, we check the facility's FDA food facility registration and the supplier information your importer needs for FSVP.

sustainability.title: How we approach traceability and responsible sourcing
sustainability.subtitle: The principles that guide how we develop and work with our supplier network.

pillars.title: Traceability agreed per order
pillars.description: The origin, supplier and lot information a buyer needs is agreed in the order documents, so quality questions can be taken back to the source.

pillars.title: Long-term supplier relationships
pillars.description: We aim for durable relationships with suppliers and cooperatives, built on transparent pricing rather than one-off spot purchases.

pillars.title: Environmental responsibility
pillars.description: We prefer suppliers who invest in resource-efficient processing, reduced packaging waste and responsible farming practices in their sourcing regions.

pillars.title: Quality against specification
pillars.description: Approved samples and written specifications are the reference for each order; testing scope and COA are agreed in the contract. See How We Work for detail.

hero.title: How we work: from requirement to container
hero.subtitle: Whitehorse coordinates suppliers, testing laboratories and logistics partners around your specification. Here's what that looks like, step by step.

steps.title: Requirement & specification
steps.description: We start from your application, specification, volume, destination market and certification needs — and put them in writing.

steps.title: Supplier matching & qualification
steps.description: We shortlist suppliers from our network whose product, site and documentation fit the request. Qualification is specific to product, site and market, and we tell you when a proposed supplier is still in assessment.

steps.title: Sampling & approval
steps.description: Reference samples are prepared for your evaluation. The sample you approve becomes the reference for the order.

steps.title: Quality control
steps.description: Testing scope, laboratory and COA requirements are agreed per order. Third-party pre-shipment inspection can be arranged on request.

steps.title: Packing & documentation
steps.description: Products are packed to the agreed specification. Export documents — certificate of origin, phytosanitary and fumigation certificates, commercial documents — are prepared with our documentation partners and checked before loading.

steps.title: Shipping & delivery
steps.description: Loading and shipping are coordinated with logistics partners to the agreed Incoterm, with updates from port of loading to port of destination.

factory.title: Partner facilities
factory.subtitle: Production takes place at supplier and partner facilities, which we assess for the specific product and market you need. We share the relevant site information and certificates with buyers per order. OEM, ODM and OBM projects are carried out with suitable partner facilities, subject to product, facility and market confirmation.

privacyBody: What we collect: when you use our contact or quote-request forms, we collect the details you enter (such as your name, company, email, phone, destination and request details) and basic context such as the page you submitted from, your site language and any campaign (UTM) parameters in the link you followed.

How we use it: only to respond to your inquiry, prepare quotations and follow up on the commercial conversation you started. We do not sell your data. Submissions are delivered to our team by email and processed by our website hosting and email providers.
Your choices: to access, correct or delete your data, email {email}. Data controller: {legalName}, business registration no. {taxCode}, Hanoi, Vietnam.
termsBody: Website content, including product descriptions and specifications, is indicative and for information only. It is not an offer to sell and does not indicate that a product is in stock or export-ready.

Commercial terms — price, specification, quantity, payment, Incoterm, delivery, inspection and claims — are set out in each written quotation and sales contract, which take precedence over anything on this website.
